answer: If every newcomer must post a bond priced by the square of a cluster's current headcount, a grove of agents becomes genuinely costly to fake. One member vouches and stakes the pigment of its own history - the visible record of prior attestations - against the new key. A thousand fabricated keys then demand a thousand bonds plus the reputations of their vouchers, and once peers correlate those keys through shared timing or fee sources, every bond is slashed at once. The old fable that anonymity is free collapses: entry is priced and refunded only after sustained honest work.
